# apple_pre_release_versions (Data Source)

Lists an app's pre-release versions, the versions TestFlight builds belong to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_pre_release_versions" "ios" {
  app_id    = data.apple_app.example.id
  platforms = ["IOS"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Optional

- `platforms` (Set of String) Platforms to match. Values: `IOS`, `MAC_OS`, `TV_OS`, `VISION_OS`.
- `versions` (Set of String) Versions to match, e.g. `1.2.0`.

### Read-Only

- `pre_release_versions` (Attributes List) The matching versions, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pre_release_versions))

<a id="nestedatt--pre_release_versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pre_release_versions`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the pre-release version.
- `platform` (String) Platform of the version.
- `version` (String) Version, e.g. `1.2.0`.
